Method of Attack: ransomware attacks targeting Internet-exposed NAS devices
Attack Vector: exploitation of remote code execution vulnerability (QSA-21-57) in QNAP NAS firmware
Indicators of Compromise: firmware versions QTS 5.0.0.1891 and later, QTS 4.5.4.1892 and later, QuTS hero h5.0.0.1892 and later, QuTS hero h4.5.4.1892 and later, QuTScloud c5.0.0.1919 and later
